title: Cosmic Crystal Ball Telescope
description: A mystical golden telescope mounted on an ornate three-legged stand peers into a large glowing crystal ball. Inside the orb swirls a vibrant purple and green vortex revealing a distant fantasy castle surrounded by ethereal butterflies and sparkling particles.
prompt: A large ornate golden telescope with a long barrel and hanging chain is mounted on a decorative three-legged stand, aimed into a massive glowing crystal sphere. Inside the sphere is a swirling purple and green vortex landscape containing a fantasy castle. White butterflies flutter around the sphere against a dark cosmic background with subtle crackle texture and glowing particles, digital painting style.
